mapper.select: SELECT P.prdt_cd, P.coal_co_cd, C.code_nm AS coal_co_nm, P.rep_prdt_cd, R.rep_prdt_nm, P.prdt_nm, P.prdt_desc, P.sale_start_date, P.sale_end_date, P.use_yn, P.created_id, P.created_at, P.updated_id, P.updated_at FROM tb_product P LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_rep_prdt R ON P.rep_prdt_cd = R.rep_prdt_cd LEFT OUTER JOIN tb_code C ON P.coal_co_cd = C.code_cd AND C.code_group_cd = 'INS_COMPANY' WHERE P.prdt_cd = #{prdtCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_product ( prdt_cd, coal_co_cd, rep_prdt_cd, prdt_nm, prdt_desc, sale_start_date, sale_end_date, use_yn, created_id, created_at ) VALUES ( #{prdtCd}, #{coalCoCd}, #{repPrdtCd}, #{prdtNm}, #{prdtDesc}, #{saleStartDate}, #{saleEndDate}, COALESCE(#{useYn}, 'Y'), 'admin_sys', NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT rep_prdt_cd, coal_co_cd, rep_prdt_nm FROM tb_rep_prdt
rep_prdt_cd LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR rep_prdt_nm LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
